title.en: Transfer of Functions of Minister of Law to Permanent Secretary of Prime Ministers Office

text.en:
9th. AUGUST, 1999 No. S 37

TRANSFER OF THE FUNCTIONS OF THE MINISTER OF LAW It is hereby notified for general information that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan has directed that with effect from the 26th. day of July, 1999 all the functions, powers, duties, privileges and benefits of the Minister of Law which have been transferred to or conferred or imposed on him by each of the written laws specified in the first column of the Schedule be transferred to the person specified opposite such written law in the second column of the Schedule.

SCHEDULE Criminal Procedure Code Permanent Secretary, Office of the (Chapter 7} Prime Minister Section 55 of the Penal Code Permanent Secretary, Office of the {Chapter 22} Prime Minister Section 75(2) of the Bankruptcy Act Permanent Secretary, Office of the {Chapter 67} Prime Minister Rules of the Supreme Court Permanent Secretary, Office of the Prime Minister Evidence Act {Chapter 108} Permanent Secretary, Office of the Prime Minister

BY COMMAND

DATO PADUKA HAJI A WANG HAZAIR BIN

HAJI A WANG ABDULLAH Permanent Secretary, Prime Minister's Office, Brunei Darussalam.
